title: OpenClaw for Developers: 12 Workflows That Replace Repetitive Dev Work
summary: PR reviews, dependency audits, release notes, issue triage, standup bots — these 12 OpenClaw workflows run 24/7 so you can focus on building instead of maintenance.
body_markdown: Yes. OpenClaw supports multiple concurrent skills and schedules on a single agent instance. The agent's heartbeat model means workflows don't block each other — each runs in its own execution context.
